subject: Coding X genotypes in an f2 intercross

messages.author: dfab579a94fa5c7b
messages.subject: Coding X genotypes in an f2 intercross
parts:
Hi Karl

I have phased genotype data from an (AxB)x(BxA) f2 intercross so my genotypes are AA, AB, BA and BB.
I am unsure how to code the X genoypes as at the moment I get the error 'ommitting n additional X chr genotypes' when reading in the cross.
For the X genotypes females are AB and BB, males are AA and BA. Should I convert the males to AA and BB?

Apologies if this has been asked before.
Thanks

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] Coding X genotypes in an f2 intercross
parts:
R/qtl can't deal with phased F2 data, unless you were going to try to treat it as a phase-known 4-way cross, in which case the coding is much more complicated.

I'd switch the coding to AA:AB:BB, and on the X chromosome males AA:BB and females AB:BB, and with a phenotype column pgm==1.

karl
